name: Casual Speaking
description: Informal communication settings such as team updates, social gatherings, or community events

pace.note: Slightly faster than average to maintain engagement in informal settings

filler_words.note: More relaxed standards for fillers in casual contexts

language.structure: conversational flow with clear main points
language.note: Balance between structure and natural conversation; avoid overly formal language

delivery.note: More animated expressions and gestures are appropriate

common_pitfalls: Not reading the room or adapting to audience
Neglecting to include everyone in the conversation
recommended_practices: Start with brief connection or ice-breaker
Have 2-3 key points to maintain focus
Use personal stories or relevant examples
Be mindful of time even in casual settings
End with clear takeaway or next steps

openers: Before we dive in, quick question for everyone...
I was thinking about this the other day...
Something interesting came up that I wanted to share...
engagement: What do you all think about...?
Has anyone had a similar experience?
I'm curious to hear your thoughts on...
Let me know if this resonates with you...

tips: Have a mental outline of 2-3 points before speaking
Notice audience reactions and adjust accordingly
Practice the art of brevity even in casual settings
Develop relevant stories that illustrate your points
Involve quieter members of the group naturally
Flex between formal and casual as appropriate
Guide group dynamics subtly without controlling
Create moments of connection that resonate
